title: 黑默丁格·发条小鸭
description: 蓬松金发大发明家戴圆护目镜，在工作台上调试小发条鸭，炮台造型模型静放一角。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Heimerdinger is a small adult yordle inventor with an enormous fluffy golden hair mass, a broad white moustache, round goggles, and tiny expressive hands. Preserve his disproportionately large hair silhouette, blue scientist coat, fully covering work clothes, and sturdy boots. A compact recognizable turret-shaped invention sits inactive on a shelf, its barrel lowered, alongside harmless large mechanical gears.
art_direction.scene: He stands on a sturdy little platform at a workbench and winds a toy duck using a simple round key. The duck rests on the table rather than moving through the air. Two large spare gears and a plain lamp suggest invention, while his raised eyebrows and delighted smile make the scene a quiet discovery.
art_direction.palette: golden yellow, white moustache, powder blue, brass
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
